what: OPERATOR DECISION (W6-P3 automation spec, option D): authorise the READ-ONLY feasibility probe for driving breakout_1's DXtrade account from our VM. Step 0 is a documented DXtrade REST login plus one read (this is option C). Steps 1-2 are a Playwright read-only login and a 72h session keep-alive. It needs BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME/PASSWORD/DOMAIN as Actions secrets, which the operator originates, and a Tier-2 secret sync to the VM. No order-placing code is involved; that is a later held Tier-2 PR.
